verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-installable inference engine: it installs locally via uv/pip or source, runs on local GPUs, CPUs and Apple Silicon, and documents an offline-inference mode alongside a locally started server, so inference runs on the user's own hardware. missing for 10: explicit documentation that prompts and data never leave the device (no-telemetry or air-gapped operation), and independent hands-on corroboration of fully local, privacy-preserving use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Install vLLM with uv (recommended) or pip:
Support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs.
Run benchmark tests for latency online serving throughput and offline inference throughput.
Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
